inputs.title: Reset Active Leg On Material Time Gap
inputs.id: Reset Active Leg On Material Time Gap
inputs.tooltip: On intraday charts, resets active structure when the gap exceeds the threshold below. An isolated missing bar normally will not reset the leg. Completed boxes remain visible. This reset is not applied on daily or higher timeframes.
On intraday charts, the interval between the prior close and the next bar open must exceed this many chart-bar durations. Raise the value to preserve more context across long session breaks.
inputs.title: Gap Reset Threshold (Chart Bars)

inputs.tooltip: Choose the movement yardstick used to scale thresholds. Median True Range uses the full true-range sample on ordinary bars; detected intraday gap bars contribute only their own high-low range, so a session jump does not distort the scale. Median Close Travel measures absolute close-to-close movement and excludes samples that span detected chart-time gaps. A leg keeps the scale measured at its birth, so its thresholds do not drift mid-leg.
inputs.title: Movement Scale

inputs.tooltip: Number of samples used by the selected median. On intraday charts, close-travel samples spanning detected time gaps are excluded. During warm-up, the current bar range is used until the median is available.
inputs.title: Median Scale Lookback

inputs.tooltip: Short windows can detect emerging movement earlier but may create more false starts.
inputs.title: Displacement Window

inputs.tooltip: The close must exceed the previous reference high or low. The current candle is excluded from that reference.
inputs.title: Breakout Reference Window

inputs.tooltip: Minimum net displacement in selected movement-scale units, combined with the breakout and efficiency conditions.
inputs.title: Birth Displacement (Scale Units)

inputs.tooltip: Net close displacement divided by the close-to-close path. Lower values can allow earlier detections but may increase false starts.
inputs.title: Minimum Directional Efficiency

inputs.tooltip: Sets the primary leg-invalidation reference from preceding bars inside the current segment. The reference stays anchored to the leg birth; ordinary continuation triggers do not move it to each newer pullback.
inputs.title: Initial Protected Structure Window

inputs.tooltip: Requires the close to clear the prior breakout level by a small fraction of the active movement scale. Helps reject marginal one-tick breaks across instruments with different prices and tick sizes.
inputs.title: Breakout Clearance (Scale Units)

inputs.tooltip: Structure Confirmed starts an opposing leg only when its drive condition and the active protected structure break agree. Early Displacement permits a qualifying opposite drive to replace the current leg sooner, with more short-lived flips in chop.
inputs.title: Opposite-Leg Confirmation
Additional Reversal Displacement (Scale Units)
inputs.tooltip: Adds a small displacement requirement only when confirming an opposite leg after protected-structure failure in Structure Confirmed mode. Ordinary drive births keep their existing threshold.
Favourable accepted progress beyond the birth close required for FORMING.
inputs.title: Forming Extension From Birth
Trend Extension From Birth Close
inputs.tooltip: Accepted progress after the confirmed birth close required for TREND. If this value is below the Forming threshold, the effective Trend threshold is kept 0.1 scale units above Forming. It is not a trade-entry prerequisite.
Minimum completed leg bars before promotion to TREND.
inputs.title: Minimum Leg Bars Before Trend

inputs.tooltip: Giveback threshold for detecting an early drive stall.
inputs.title: Drive Stall Giveback

inputs.tooltip: Giveback threshold during FORMING and TREND. The warning remains independent of trend phase.
inputs.title: Forming / Trend Giveback
Failed Extension Buffer
inputs.tooltip: Minimum excursion beyond the best accepted close required for the failed-extension route to qualify.

inputs.title: Bars Without New Accepted Progress
inputs.tooltip: Alternative exhaustion route: sufficient giveback plus this many consecutive bars without new accepted progress.
The yellow exhaustion event is latched. It rearms only after meaningful accepted progress beyond the close recorded when the warning occurred.
inputs.title: New Progress Required To Rearm

inputs.tooltip: A continuation trigger requires a close through this many preceding bars' reference high or low, after a sufficient pullback.
inputs.title: Local Reclaim Reference

inputs.tooltip: Minimum retracement from the best accepted close, measured in scale units, required before a continuation setup can qualify.
inputs.title: Minimum Pullback Depth
Giveback Phase Threshold
inputs.tooltip: Distance away from the best accepted close required to enter GIVEBACK.
Additional favourable progress required between successive oscillator milestones.
inputs.title: Accepted Progress Milestone
Balance Observation Window
inputs.tooltip: Full segment-local history is required before balance can be accepted.
Maximum net displacement relative to the close-to-close path.
inputs.title: Maximum Balance Efficiency

inputs.tooltip: Minimum range width in movement-scale units.
inputs.title: Minimum Balance Width

inputs.tooltip: Number of consecutive completed bars that must meet the balance conditions.
inputs.title: Required Balance Bars

inputs.tooltip: Required close beyond a stored balance boundary to release balance. Release does not guarantee a new trend.
inputs.title: Balance Release Buffer

inputs.tooltip: Number of confirmed bars spent in an accepted balance before its grey fill becomes more prominent. Separate from the balance-detection persistence requirement.
inputs.title: Established Balance Duration
Historical Drawing Capacity
inputs.tooltip: Retention budget for outer leg containers, inner phase-colour bands, and balance boxes. Oldest drawings are removed first to stay within TradingView object limits.

inputs.title: Show Price-Chart Events
inputs.tooltip: Shows confirmed drive-birth, exhaustion, balance, and protected-structure-failure markers. Continuation triggers appear in the oscillator pane and can be included in the consolidated confirmed alert.

inputs.title: Show Oscillator Event Markers
inputs.tooltip: Shows small pane markers for accepted progress, continuation, and exhaustion.
Displays a neutral grey field that expands as price gives back progress.
inputs.title: Show Giveback Field

inputs.tooltip: Live Preview lets the open candle update the provisional birth marker, active envelope, giveback field, and scanner distances. These visuals can change before close. Confirmed Only holds the display to completed-bar information. Neither mode changes confirmed state transitions or alert timing.
inputs.title: Display Mode

inputs.tooltip: Create one TradingView alert using 'Any alert() function call'. Only confirmed bar-close events are sent.
inputs.title: Enable Confirmed Alerts
Drive Births
inputs.tooltip: Include confirmed bullish and bearish drive-birth events.

inputs.title: Phase Changes
inputs.tooltip: Include confirmed FORMING and TREND phase transitions.

inputs.title: Continuation Triggers
inputs.tooltip: Include confirmed long and short continuation triggers.
Include exhaustion warnings and protected-structure failures.
inputs.title: Exhaustion and Structure Failures
Balance Events
inputs.tooltip: Include accepted balance and balance-release events.
